BiomeSpy 1.3.3 (Minecraft 1.20.1, Forge)
Copyright (c) 2025 MoePus
Licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License, version 3 or later.

FRMC ports BiomeSpy's biome envelope search, its /locate biome and /locate structure
rewrites, and its Alex's Caves and TerraBlender compatibility code into source. Following
FRMC's layout (mixins live under the package of the class they target, integrations under the
mod they integrate with, everything else under capability), the ported files are in:

  com.y271727uy.FRMC.capability.worldgen.locate          envelope search, /locate rewrites
  com.y271727uy.FRMC.integration.alexscaves.locate       Alex's Caves compatibility
  com.y271727uy.FRMC.integration.terrablender.locate     TerraBlender compatibility
  com.y271727uy.FRMC.mixin.minecraft.worldgen.locate     mixins into vanilla classes
  com.y271727uy.FRMC.mixin.terrablender.LevelUtilsMixin  mixin into TerraBlender
  com.y271727uy.FRMC.mixin.alexscaves.BiomeGenerationNoiseConditionAccessor
      (BiomeSpy's accessor fields merged into FRMC's existing accessor)

FRMC does not bundle the BiomeSpy JAR. Each ported file keeps the original copyright
notice. The complete license text is in BiomeSpy-LICENSE.txt and is also packaged as
META-INF/licenses/BiomeSpy-LICENSE.txt in the FRMC artifact.

Changes made by FRMC:
  - Package names and mixin configuration adapted to FRMC.
  - Removed StructureCheckMixin, which cleared vanilla's StructureCheck feature cache on
    every checkStart call and so disabled that cache for normal gameplay.
  - Removed the biomespy:uninit_safe structure tag shortcut, which let /locate report
    buried treasure, igloos and ruined portals without confirming a valid structure start.
  - Removed an unused public clone() override from the TerraBlender ParameterList mixin.
